scope: Six-family candidate slate before the active 46-route current-matrix probes finish. No candidate is a family champion or formal whole-aircraft result until its current probe passes, its adapter and named harness pass minimum closure, and the completed family is selected for seven-scenario A/B.
selection_criteria: The current-root graphical core must first pass its active G6 internal fixed-input probe.
The candidate has a deterministic implementation reference suitable for an explicit adapter.
The candidate represents its nominal family without borrowing a fixed integrated chain from another family.
The candidate remains blocked from seven-scenario A/B until its own formal binding passes minimum closure.

official_pid_baseline.semantic_boundary: The G6 graphical official_pid entry is AWFF_PID_Sysblock_Demo, an altitude-loop internal probe. It is not claimed to be the same full controller as this separate Official PID A/B baseline binding.

candidates.selection_reason: Cascade PID is the family-level graphical core; Official PID remains a separate A/B baseline because the current official_pid graphical entry is only an AWFF altitude-loop demo.
LQR gives a deterministic state-feedback representative for the classic/robust family; its current-root graphical probe must be rerun after namespace migration.
Super-Twisting SMC is the selected reduced-chattering sliding-mode representative; its current-root graphical probe must be rerun after namespace migration.
Linear MPC is the deterministic optimization-family representative; advanced variants remain available for later follow-up but are not substituted into this first formal binding.
The high-order attitude-output DFBC route matches the ATTITUDE_THRUST runner boundary; its current-root graphical probe must be rerun after namespace migration.

The trained neural residual route has a frozen bounded-learning implementation reference; its current-root graphical probe must be rerun after namespace migration and its fallback must remain observable in the formal adapter.
